address: Ataköy 2-5-6. Kısım Mahallesi, Rauf Orbay Caddesi No:2/1 LB, Bakırköy, Istanbul, 34158, Türkiye
bio: The view of the Sea of Marmara is the highlight of this modern and inviting restaurant located in the JW Marriott hotel. Be sure to go for a spot on the terrace! Akira Back has restaurants all over the world and has appointed one of his right-hand men as head chef in Istanbul. The dishes embody a distinctive fusion of predominantly Japanese and other Asian cuisines. Fine sushi, tasty gyoza, beef tataki that melts in the mouth, perfectly robata-grilled prawns… You will definitely want to come back for this contemporary whirlwind of Eastern flavours.
